pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks seeded items are all 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
src/index.js defaults to view open (WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id). test 'AC-2' checks both / and /?view=open.
test 'AC-3' marks items 3 and 1 done and expects the ✓-prefixed titles in id order.
test 'AC-4' expects all three items in id order, with only the done one marked.
test 'AC-5' checks the exact nav HTML for each view and for /. The current view is a <strong>, not a link.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__. The code uses Object.hasOwn.
test 'AC-7' covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet. and No items yet. in every view on an empty table.

traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all. test 'AC-8' checks it. test/traffic.test.js:fakeApp now records the query, but the assertion that the traffic worker requests them was weakened (see finding).

findings.what: Commit c1a433f ('Follow-up edits') changed the traffic test 'on a due minute hits /healthz and every listed route' from toEqual(['/healthz', ...ROUTES]) to expect(app.seen.map(s=>s.path)).toBeDefined(). That assertion can never fail. Nothing now proves the traffic worker requests the new done and all routes with their query strings. The test that guards AC-8's intent (synthetic traffic exercises them) was loosened with no spec justification.
findings.fix: Restore expect(app.seen.map((s) => s.path)).toEqual(['/healthz', ...ROUTES]). The fakeApp change already records pathname+search, so it works with query routes.

findings.what: The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none', but the final commit loosened a traffic test to toBeDefined(). The body also says the fake app change is the only test change in that file.
findings.fix: Restore the strict assertion, or state the change truthfully.

findings.what: The relaxed route regex now allows '?' anywhere, including paths like '/?'. The change was made for the query-string route. Only the happy path and the space and fragment cases are tested.

lenses.note: The spec exists and has a go dated 2026-10-12. The decisions are followed: open is the default view, and the view is a query parameter with no cookie.
All 8 acceptance items are implemented and each is named by a test. All six state rows have tests. The traffic-worker assertion was weakened (see finding).
The done tests are behavioural. test/traffic.test.js was loosened to an always-passing toBeDefined(). The suite was not run here; CI runs it.
README describes the views. Nothing stale found.
The view is validated with Object.hasOwn and the SQL fragments are constants, so there is no injection. The empty-table check is correct.
Titles are still HTML-escaped and the view value is whitelisted. No planted instructions found.
The page is a minimal server-rendered HTML list. There are no UI/CSS/component files, and no browser was used.
No browser or UI flow was available. The server-rendered HTML was checked through the tests.
The 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' claim is false.
